mission.evacuation_item_reason: This is a <color=#FFFEC1>valuable item</color>. Getting it pays for having to restart the shuttle. Great job.
mission.evacuation_vip_died: The VIP was killed. We can <color=#FFFEC1>evacuate the clone</color> with all looted items, or find a way to <color=#FFFEC1>revive the VIP</color>.
mission.evacuation.in_process: Find the elevator and get <color=#FFFEC1>upstairs</color>. We'll pick you up there.
mission.evacuation.in_process_defense: Find a shuttle and come back. The Magnum's ready to pick you up.

mission.mercurySurfaceLevels.stage2.name: Floor 2
mission.mercurySurfaceLevels.stage3.name: Floor 3
mission.mercurySurfaceLevels.stage4.name: Floor 4
mission.mercurySurfaceLevels.stage5.name: Floor 5
mission.mercurySurfaceLevels.stage6.name: Floor 6

mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Control1.after: Great job, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. The pirates prepared and sent valuable cargo to Magnum as a reward.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Control1.briefi: We have marked the location of the warehouse on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them and <color=#FFFEC1>do not let the warehouse be destroyed</color>.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Control1.detail: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> and the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> hate each other as much as corporations. Mutual accusations between these groups are the essence of politics in the <color=#FFFEC1>Main Belt</color>. So, the pirate crew from %STATION_NAME% asks us to help <color=#FFFEC1>protect the resource warehouse</color>. The colnodes are trying to destroy it, sparing no effort and time.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Control1.object: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>protect the pirate warehouse</color>. It is a mountain of boxes. You yourself have seen them many times in the cargo hold of Magnum.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Defense1.after: The pirates retained control of %STATION_NAME%. Direct actions proved to be a losing strategy for the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. This means that they will now move on to murder, espionage and sabotage. There will be work for us here soon. In the meantime, Magnum received a cargo from the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color>.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Defense1.briefi: It is necessary to <color=#FFFEC1>take a defensive position</color> and hold out long enough for the attackers to understand that this time they will not succeed. We have one mission: to ensure that %STATION_NAME% remains in the hands of pirates when the dust settles and the smoke clears.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Defense1.detail:
Details: the Civil Resistance is actively interfering with pirates throughout the Solar System. They seem like they should only be a problem for corporations, but the Unchained Belt is also suffering. %STATION_NAME% is now the target of so-called "direct actions" by terrorists. Yes, we are talking about capture. Pirate crews from the station send announcements of a reward for participation in the defense of %STATION_NAME%.

Simple task: we land in the place specified by the customer and eliminate all the colnodes. Let's hold the station, and the gratitude of the Unchained Belt will be very significant.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Elimination1.af: Another fanatic destroyed. The pirate who delivered the reward to Magnum said that they would be glad not to fight against the rebels, but they asked for it.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Elimination1.br: The target is marked on your map: they are among the personnel of %STATION_NAME%. The shuttle will land wherever it can. The colnodes will put up fierce resistance. <color=#FFFEC1>Eliminate the fanatic and return</color>. Try not to get too distracted exploring %STATION_NAME%, it's not our priority.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Elimination1.de:
Details: Capitalist anarchy reigns in the Solar System, controlled by NCE. However, groups that are not part of the ancap system live in real hell.

Now %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of the Civil Resistance. Agents of the Unchained Belt managed to find out that one of the commanders of the CR colnodes was located here. The pirates are asking us to rid the System of a dangerous fanatic.

The elimination of an experienced colnode will send a message to the rebels that it is better not to mess with pirates.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Elimination1.ob: Search and destroy is a routine job. <color=#FFFEC1>Your target</color>: a colnode commander. They will shoot back, so be careful.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Escort1.after: The <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> is grateful for the rescue of the experienced captain. The pirates who were loading the reward onto Magnum seemed like good guys to me.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Escort1.briefin: The target's location is marked on your map. <color=#FFFEC1>Escort</color> the pirate commander to the specified location on %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. The attackers are the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnodes. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the captain of the pirate crew to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Escort1.details:
Details: %STATION_NAME% has long been in the hands of pirates. An experienced pirate commander uses it to systematically spoil everyone who interferes with the Unchained Belt. This does not suit both the corporation and the Civil Resistance.

The rebels placed a contract for PMC to eliminate the station commander %STATION_NAME%. We can take a contract from the pirates to protect them. If we need to improve our relationship with the Unchained Belt, there is no better way.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Escort1.objecti: Escort is a routine job. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the commander to the safe location specified by the pirates.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Espionage1.afte:
The Civil Resistance is forced to change all operational plans at %STATION_NAME%. They suspect that the organizer of the attack is the Unchained Belt. If the colnodes decide to take revenge, it will be possible to accept a contract from them as well.

The commander of the pirate crew took the PCPU and gave us the reward, it is already on the spacecraft.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Espionage1.brie: The sensors found the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color>. However, the alarms at %STATION_NAME% have already been raised. <color=#FFFEC1>Take the device and come back</color>. Only be distracted by something if absolutely necessary.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Take the Civil Resistance PCPU from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Espionage1.deta: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Recently, %STATION_NAME% has been the main center of operations for the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. Many raids organized from here were carried out against pirate crews. Therefore, the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> would do well to know about the plans of the colnodes. This can be organized: we infiltrate %STATION_NAME%, find the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color>, and the pirates will be forced to exchange the data for something valuable.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Espionage1.obje: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Take the Civil Resistance PCPU from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Infiltration1.a: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is forced to look for another way to find out about the pirates' plans. We have already received our reward, but it seems that events around this station are only gaining momentum.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Infiltration1.b:
HIS of the Civil Resistance hovered nearby. Surely they already know where the PCPU is located. It is necessary to prevent infiltration of %STATION_NAME% by destroying all groups of colnodes.

Pirates are usually not too concerned about the safety of property: they do not hope to hold the station for long. Therefore, they won’t notice the loss of a couple of things, but it’s better not to be distracted from the main task.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Infiltration1.d:
Details: %STATION_NAME% is the main center of operations of the Unchained Belt against the Civil Resistance. The pirates learned that the rebels had located this place and were preparing a spy operation.

The target of the colnodes would be the PCPU with important data. If the device is stolen, the pirates will have to redo all operational and strategic plans.

If we want to receive a reward for this contract, we must eliminate all the rebel infiltration teams that will come for the PCPU.
The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has lost a convenient station for organizing raids. The pirates have already delivered our reward to Magnum.

10 seconds until landing. As soon as the colnodes guarding %STATION_NAME% realize that the battle is lost, they will retreat or lay down their arms. It is enough to destroy 50% of the combatants.

Keep your eyes open! If you understand that you have enough strength and resources, you can explore this place. Apart from the capture, nothing else is included in the contract, that is, the customer will accept %STATION_NAME% in any condition. Pirates don't get to choose.

Details: The Unchained Belt uses the chaos of the new redistribution of property. Pirates throughout the System began sabotage, murder, and espionage. %STATION_NAME% is now the target of so-called "direct actions". That is, capture.

Simple task: we go in, kill everyone who is capable of holding weapons, and leave before this place becomes another branch of hell. The Civil Resistance has already sent colnodes to protect %STATION_NAME%.

By the way, I almost forgot. Capturing a station always pays well. And a trusting relationship with the Unchained Belt will not hurt us at all.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Robbery1.after: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> will be dealing with the mess we created at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The pirates took the goods and gave us something very valuable, probably stolen from one of the corporations.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Robbery1.briefi: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: find and pick up valuable items on each floor of the station. Smash and destroy everything you want, but take the goods. After that, evacuate.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Robbery1.detail: Sometimes pirates are not averse to making money not only at the expense of corporations. Agents of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> have learned that there are <color=#FFFEC1>valuable items</color> at %STATION_NAME%. They would be useful for pirates to intensify their activities in this region of the Solar System. The fanatics from the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> clearly have no use for them. We can show the pirates what an exemplary robbery raid is.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Robbery1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Sabotage1.after: Great job, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. The pirate crew overseeing the operation prepared and sent valuable cargo to Magnum.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Sabotage1.brief: We have marked the locations of the <color=#FFFEC1>stockpiles</color> on your map. Do not expect to be dropped too close. The stockpiles are securely hidden deep within %STATION_NAME%. <color=#FFFEC1>Find and destroy a pile of crates</color>. You are allowed to deviate from the main task only if you find something truly important.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Sabotage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the resource warehouse of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> at %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Sabotage1.detai:
Details: Unfortunately, it is not only corporations that prevent gentlemen of fortune from making money. Fanatics of the Civil Resistance still believe in some ideals and a mythical state.

Currently, at %STATION_NAME%, the colnodes have created a resource warehouse. The liaison of the Unchained Belt offers to destroy it in order to stir up this anthill. The pirates are quietly planning to kidnap several colnodes and try to bring them to their senses.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Sabotage1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> stockpiles. A stockpile is a pile of crates. You have seen such piles many times in the cargo hold of the Magnum.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Security1.after: The pirates will have to deal with the mess that the colnodes created at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. We also took part in this, but received a reward.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Security1.brief: The %VICTIM_NAME% has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Captains of %BENEFICIARY_NAME% will consider it a failure if even one such squad manages to escape.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Security1.detai: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> attacks %STATION_NAME%, regardless of losses. The pirate crew that holds the defense there is asking for help. If we respond, we will need to provide the colnodes with a worthy meeting: hold off their attacks until reinforcements from the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> arrive. It seems that the rebels really need something at this station, and they will attack as long as there is even a slight chance of success. <color=#FFFEC1>Our task</color>: hold out long enough.
mission.Pirates_CivilRes_Security1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the colnode squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Control1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is already spreading information about its unprecedented success in the fight against piracy. Of course, without evidence. I think the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> will win sooner or later. The ancap system needs to feed less on its own propaganda.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Control1.briefing: The location of the pirate warehouse has been transferred to your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. <color=#FFFEC1>Eliminate everyone, protect the warehouse</color>.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Control1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the pirate crew's supply warehouse.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Control1.details:
Details: The Unchained Belt has seriously strengthened at %STATION_NAME%. It carried out several successful raids from here. But the last robbery attack on %VICTIM_NAME% was a mistake. Its analysts tracked the pirates to %STATION_NAME%. Gentlemen of fortune are preparing for defense.

We must prevent corporate henchmen from destroying the supplies collected here. If we help the Unchained Belt, we will receive not only respect, but also some of the salvaged equipment.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Control1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Protect the pirate crew's supply warehouse.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Defense1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is conducting a massive information campaign to save its reputation after a failed attack on %STATION_NAME%. The reward from the grateful pirates is already on board Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Defense1.briefing: %STATION_NAME% is at your complete disposal. Most of the equipment here is stuff taken from corporations. If you take something for yourself, the pirates won't mind. The main thing is to <color=#FFFEC1>hold out</color> long enough, and the corporate fighters will retreat.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Defense1.details:
Details: Today we will take the side of a criminal organization. Let's not let the corporates take control of %STATION_NAME%. %VICTIM_NAME% actively posts messages in the SBN about the inadmissibility of this asset’s continued presence in the hands of pirates. This is a signal for us.

Our task: take a defensive position and eliminate corporate mercenaries until they give up trying to storm the station. The belt promises to reward our efforts well.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Elimination1.after:
%VICTIM_NAME% has launched an information campaign about the need to completely eradicate piracy in the System. When and if they want to strike with retaliation, why don't we take on that job too?

The pirate crew delivered a reward to Magnum. Interesting people. Sometimes I wonder if someone in the Unchained Belt might be interested in the resume of a smart tactical dispatcher?
mission.Pirates_Corp_Elimination1.briefi: Good news: the target is located at %STATION_NAME%. The shuttle will land wherever it can. And then your work will begin. Moderate resistance is expected from the Security Service of %VICTIM_NAME% or the PMCs working for them. There's no difference, is there? <color=#FFFEC1>If you eliminate the target, come back</color>. Try not to get too distracted exploring %STATION_NAME%, it's not our priority.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Elimination1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate a high-ranking manager of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Elimination1.detail:
Details: People from the Unchained Belt contacted us. Space pirates report that %VICTIM_NAME% is distressed by a series of successful attacks on its spacecrafts and stations. The manager sent to deal with the situation plans an attack on objects occupied by pirates throughout the System. Now they are at %STATION_NAME%.

We can help the pirates stay here by eliminating this person. At the same time, we will test the strength of the defense of %VICTIM_NAME%. The warehouses of the Unchained Belt are full of loot, and we're sure to get something valuable.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Elimination1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate a high-ranking manager of %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Escort1.after: I think many in the System have heard that %VICTIM_NAME% is not capable of performing even the simple job of eliminating the pirate captain. I wouldn’t be surprised if a new order arrives soon against the same corporation.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Escort1.briefing: You need to escort the pirate captain to the specified location. Nothing complicated. Move from level to level until you are safe. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Escort1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the captain of the pirate crew to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Escort1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> The <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> has long held %STATION_NAME% in its hands. This place has been turned into a natural hangout. The pirates have attracted the attention of %VICTIM_NAME%. An operation is being prepared to eliminate a successful pirate captain - a pain in the corporate ass. We can help The <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> if we escort the captain to the safe location at %STATION_NAME%.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Escort1.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Escort the captain of the pirate crew to the safe location.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Espionage1.after: One of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> agents took the prototype. In return, they left some of the loot from the corporations. We exchange the worst for the bad.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Espionage1.briefing: %STATION_NAME% has an unusual signature. There is a 99.9% chance that this is the prototype the <color=#FFFEC1>pirates</color> need. We'll drop you off as close to your target as possible. Make your way through the security, <color=#FFFEC1>take the device and return</color>. If you decide to look for something unusual at %STATION_NAME%, make sure it's worth the risk.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the prototype of a new invention at %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Espionage1.details:
Details: All pirate crews are associated with the Unchained Belt. It is not clear whether they have any kind of ideology or whether this is some kind of trade union for all gentlemen of fortune. In any case, the Unchained Belt is here to stay. Now they are expanding their assets and even starting their own production.

Space pirates have found out that at %STATION_NAME%, engineers from %VICTIM_NAME% are developing a prototype device. If they manage to steal the prototype, the Belt will be able to compete with the corporations on an equal footing.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Espionage1.objectiv: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the prototype of the invention and return with it to Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Infiltration1.after: %VICTIM_NAME% is forced to look for another way to learn about the plans of the pirates in this part of the Solar System. I think that events around %STATION_NAME% are only gaining momentum.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Infiltration1.brief: The pirate %STATION_NAME% is in chaos, but the anti-space defenses are working as they should. Only a portion of the corporation's fighters will break through. Find them and eliminate them.
mission.Pirates_Corp_Infiltration1.detai: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> %STATION_NAME% is the main center of operations for one daring pirate crew. Agents of the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> learned that %VICTIM_NAME% plans to obtain information from %STATION_NAME%. The target is the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> pirate crew. If we want to make a profitable deal with the successful bandits, we must eliminate all the corporate infiltration teams.
mission.Pirates_Corp_RaiderCapture1.afte: %VICTIM_NAME% raised a howl in the <color=#FFFEC1>SBN</color> on the topic of terrorism and non-compliance with laws. All you need to do is take a closer look at your property! By the way, the pirates delivered the cargo due to us for our participation in the attack. It's already aboard Magnum.
mission.Pirates_Corp_RaiderCapture1.brie: %STATION_NAME% is at your complete disposal. Act methodically, the enemy is clear to you - this is its own security service or PMCs hired by the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME%. Once their losses become too great, they will leave this place. Keep your eyes open so you don't find yourself without the necessary supplies at a critical moment.
